name: Water Infrastructure Finance Authority of Arizona (WIFA)
collect_note: Reads WIFA's news listing twice a day and keeps only releases that announce a Water Conservation Grant Fund round (call words in the title or teaser), reads a deadline from the release text ('accept applications until <date>') and holds them as candidates; the WCGF round of 2025 was announced as 'WIFA Opens New Round of Conservation Grants'. WIFA has no calls listing, feed or JSON API (jsonapi 500, no RSS).

zero_reason.quote: WIFA will accept applications until  March 6, 2025 .
zero_reason.note: The last WCGF round closed 2025-03-06; the WCGF program page lists no open application period today. Filter tested against the title of that last release, WIFA Opens New Round of Conservation Grants (Feb 4, 2025).

evidence: Channels tried 2026-11-12: endpoint_recon on /news (verdict html_ok, no opportunity endpoint); /jsonapi/node/article HTTP 500; sitemap.xml 71 urls, program pages only; no RSS or atom link; WCGF page has no application listing (applications run through the eCivis portal, login-based). /news is a Drupal views list (div.views-row, h2 a, .field--name-node-post-date), 10 per page.
